title: New England Lobster Rolls in Buttered, Toasted Buns
summary: Cooked lobster is folded through a light mayonnaise, celery, lemon and chive dressing, then served cold in hot, butter-toasted buns lined with lettuce.

ingredients.item: cooked lobster meat, in 1-2 cm chunks
hot dog buns (top-split if you can find them)

steps.title: Make the salad
steps.text: Whisk the mayonnaise, celery, lemon juice, chives and cayenne in the bowl. Fold in the lobster gently so the chunks stay whole, then chill while you toast the buns.

steps.title: Toast the buns
steps.text: Spread the outsides of the buns with the butter. Toast them in the pan over medium-low heat for 2-3 minutes per side until crisp and golden.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Line each bun with a lettuce leaf, pile in the lobster salad and serve straight away, while the bun is warm and the filling cold.

tips: Use just enough mayonnaise to coat; the lobster should be the star.
Pat cooked lobster meat dry so the dressing doesn't turn watery.
Top-split buns are traditional because they have flat sides to toast.
storage: Not suitable for storing once assembled. Keep the lobster salad covered in the fridge below 5 °C and use within 1 day. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
